article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Jake Oettinger made 26 saves for his second straight shutout, Mikko Rantanen had a goal and three assists and the Dallas Stars beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-0 on Thursday night. Oettinger has 18 career shutouts. He stopped 13 shots Monday night in a 5-0 home victory over San Jose. Jason Robertson, Sam Steel and Roope Hintz also scored to help Dallas win its second in a row after two opening losses. Wyatt Johnston had three assists. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen stopped 14 shots for Buffalo. The Sabres had won the first two games of a five-game homestand. Robertson scored at 9:03 of the first period and the Stars added three more in the second. Sam Steel connected on a snap shot at 9:36, Rantanen scored on a backhander with 6:03 left and Roope put in a snapper on a power play with 4:26 remaining. Up next Stars: At Pittsburgh on Saturday night. Sabres: Host Utah on Saturday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
